gap: No result ChatGPT got states what the Elite 30 V2's 100 W panel buys over BLUETTI's own 60 W bundle. On BLUETTI's US store today the 100 W kit costs $90 more ($489.99 vs $399.99) and cuts the minimum full-sun refill of the 288 Wh battery from 4.8 h to 2.9 h. The 100 W panel still uses only half the station's 200 W solar input; BLUETTI says 200 W of solar gives a full charge in 2.2 h.
standout_why: I compared against the four pages ChatGPT got that were cited or are ours. Our own page (dealectric.com, read 2026-11-14) gives cost per Wh and a refill time of about 3.8 h at 75% panel output, but it lists no weights and does not mention the 60 W bundle. solar-home.space gives 288 Wh-class Wh per lb only for the Jackery Explorer 300 v2 (35.1) and EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus (27.5), plus 9.5 h from a 40 W panel; it gives no weight or Wh per lb for the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 or Anker C300. solutionenergy.com works out kit weight and Wh per lb only for kits of 1 kWh and up, such as the Jackery 1000 v2 + 200 W (38.1 lb, 28.1 Wh/lb). campequipmentplus.com divides battery Wh by panel W only for large kits and gives no prices. None of them prices the 60 W versus 100 W panel step for the pick, and none says the 100 W panel uses half of the Elite 30 V2's solar input.
decides: This confirms the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W as the pick and makes it more specific. Against the Anker C300 it gives twice the AC output (600 W vs 300 W) for about 0.4 lb more (9.5 lb vs 9.1 lb). The extra $90 for the 100 W bundle saves about 1.9 h of full sun per refill, which matters on a weekend when one sunny afternoon has to refill the battery. A camper who mostly charges from the car or the wall can buy the $399.99 + 60 W bundle and save $90. A camper who wants the fastest solar refill should know the station accepts 200 W of solar, so a second panel would roughly halve the refill time again. A note for the writer: ChatGPT showed an 'Anker SOLIX C300 + 60 W' card at $399.99, but Anker's own store today lists only the C300 station at $429.99 and no C300 + 60 W bundle. The search covered the full C300 listing, so this is not a gap in my research.
